title: Watching Cloud Connector upgrades: VM record fields, upgrade metrics and upgrade events

prose.text: Upgrade progress can be read three ways: from each VM's record, from fleet-wide upgrade metrics, and from the upgrade events a connector streams.

prose.label: Per VM.
prose.text: {{vm-upgrade-fields}} What the integer upgrade status means is open, with the VM status flags, in [[cloud-connector.insights.connector-status:vm-status-codes]].

prose.label: As events.
prose.text: The start and end of each upgrade, with Success or Fail, are streamed as event logs: [[cloud-connector.logs.event-records:upgrade-events]].

checks.do: Whether any VMs are counted as failed or blocked in the upgrade metrics after a window.
Whether an UPGRADE_END event with severity Error arrived for the connector, which names the failure where the integer status does not.

vm-upgrade-fields.statement: A VM record carries `lastUpgradeTime`, `upgradeStartTime`, `upgradeEndTime`, `upgradeDayOfWeek` (documented as Sunday by default) and `upgradeStatus`, an int32 described only as the scheduled upgrade status, with no enum.

expect.description: The scheduled upgrade status of the VM.
The scheduled upgrade day of the week. By default, this is Sunday.

lastUpgradeTime.description: The date and time when the VM was last upgraded.

upgradeStartTime.description: The start time of the VM upgrade.

upgradeEndTime.description: The end time of the VM upgrade.

upgrade-metrics.statement: A group API read returns Cloud Connector release-channel and scheduled-upgrade metrics: counts of VMs per release channel and per upgrade state (blocked, bootstrapping, failed, scheduled, up to date), filterable by platform, release channel, location, group name and upgrade status (SCHEDULED, NO_PENDING_UPGRADE, FAILED_OTHER, BOOTSTRAPPING, BLOCKED).

expect.description: Retrieves the Cloud Connector VMs release channel and scheduled upgrade metrics.
The location ID of the Cloud Connector group.

beta.description: The total number of VMs with beta release channel.

latest.description: The total number of VMs with latest release channel.

stable.description: The total number of VMs with stable release channel.

blocked.description: The total number of VMs with blocked upgrade status.

bootStrapping.description: The total number of VMs with bootstarping upgrade status.

failed.description: The total number of VMs with failed upgrade status.

scheduled.description: The total number of VMs with scheduled upgrade status.

upToDate.description: The total number of VMs with up to date upgrade status.
